name: Create voiceovers with karaoke subtitles using Edge TTS and FFmpeg

parameters.content:
## Create voiceovers with karaoke subtitles using Edge TTS

Turns any text into an **MP3 voiceover plus a word-by-word karaoke subtitle file**, for free. No API key, no account, no credits — Edge TTS is Microsoft Edge's built-in Read Aloud voice, reachable from the open-source `edge-tts` CLI.

Most caption workflows fake karaoke timing by dividing the clip length evenly across the words. Edge TTS audio is roughly a quarter silence — a lead-in, a ~1s pause at every full stop, a tail — so that stretches every word and the highlight drifts behind the voice. This one measures the real silences with ffmpeg and lays the words on speech time only, so each sentence starts exactly on its first syllable.

### How it works

1. A form takes your text and a language (7 included).
2. The language is mapped to an Edge TTS voice name.
3. `edge-tts` speaks the text to an MP3.
4. `ffprobe` reads the duration and `silencedetect` finds every pause.
5. Word timings are laid out on the speech, sentence by sentence.
6. An `.ass` subtitle is written with `\k` karaoke tags, wrapped by character width so long-word languages stay inside the frame.

You get back the MP3 and the .ass file. Burn them in with ffmpeg, or drop them into any editor.

### Setup

- `pipx install edge-tts`
- ffmpeg + ffprobe on the PATH of the process running n8n
- **Self-hosted n8n only.** This uses Execute Command, which n8n Cloud does not allow. n8n v2 also disables it by default — start n8n with `NODES_EXCLUDE="[]"` and `N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO="/tmp"` or the file steps fail silently.

### Customization tips

Add a language by adding one row to the VOICES map. Run `edge-tts --list-voices` to see all 300+. Font, size and margins live in the ASS style line.

## 1. Input
Your text and language. Add languages in the voice map.

## 2. Speak the text
edge-tts writes an MP3. Free, no account.

## 3. Measure the real speech
ffprobe reads the length, silencedetect finds every pause.

## 4. Build the karaoke subtitle
Word timings on speech only, then an .ass file with \k tags.

## Self-hosted only
Execute Command does not exist on n8n Cloud. See Setup in the overview.

nodes.notes: edge-tts reads from a file, which avoids shell-quoting the text.

nodes.name: Speak the text with Edge TTS
nodes.notes: Free, no account, no key. Install with: pipx install edge-tts

parameters.command: =edge-tts --voice {{ $('Pick the Edge TTS voice').item.json.voice }} --file "{{ $('Prepare file paths for this run').item.json.textPath }}" --write-media "{{ $('Prepare file paths for this run').item.json.audioPath }}"

nodes.name: Measure duration and find the pauses
nodes.notes: silencedetect logs at INFO level, so -v error would hide it. '|| true' because grep exits 1 when a clip has no silence at all, which is a valid result.

parameters.command: =ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "{{ $('Prepare file paths for this run').item.json.audioPath }}" && ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostats -i "{{ $('Prepare file paths for this run').item.json.audioPath }}" -af silencedetect=noise=-40dB:d=0.15 -f null - 2>&1 | grep -oE "silence_(start|end): [0-9.]+" || true

nodes.notes: Lays words on speech time only and anchors every sentence to the audio it is spoken in.

nodes.notes: Wraps by character width so long-word languages stay inside the frame.
